Name: Brandini's Portraits
Author: BrandinisMods
Description:
[size=6]﻿What is this mod?
[/size][size=3]I used [b]Stardew Valley Character Portrait maker (by [size=3]Poltergeister [/size]and Jazzybee[/b][b])[/b] to make the characters then edited them to make them feel and look more like my style. The characters currently not finished are: Linus, Birdie, Safari Guy, Fizz, Bear, Governor, Grandpa, Leo, and the Answering Machine. This mod was [b]made for SDV 1.6 [/b]and I have [b]NOT [/b]tested it with SDV 1.5 or below.

[b]Will be adding sprites for each character as I update the mod.[/b] 

If you're wondering why I used [size=3]Stardew Valley Character Portrait [/size]maker, well it's because I am very new to doing character (pixel) art and
wanted something to start off with. In the future I hope to make all of
my own portraits myself in my own art style.

Also this is my first ever mod and I hope you enjoy it!!!

[/size][size=6]Installation.
[/size][size=3]This is a Content Patcher mod, so it is REQUIRED.

[/size][size=5]Installation Method I.[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=3]To install with [size=3]Content Patcher[/size]:
Drag the folder from the inside of the .zip file into your mods folder.

[b]If you are using Rasmodia mod then switch wizard.png to rasmodia.png in the content.json[/b][size=3]
[/size][/size][size=6]
Additional Notes.
[/size][size=3]Please check out [size=3]Jazzybee and [size=3]Poltergeister's [/size][/size][/size][url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdvcharactercreator][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][b]Stardew Valley Character Portrait Maker[/b][/size][/size][/size][/size][/url][size=6]
